files.notes/2026-10-13-call.md:
# Call 2026-10-13 - ingest batch size

Present: Mira, Tomas, Ines.

Decided: cut the ingest batch size from 500 readings to 100.

Why: at 500, one malformed reading fails the whole batch, and last week that dropped 2,000 readings in one night; at 100 a bad reading costs a fifth as much. Throughput at 100 was measured at 9,400 readings per second on the staging box, above the 6,000 per second peak.

Considered and rejected: keeping 500 and validating each reading first (validation adds 40 ms per batch, and the vendor changes its schema every month); committing each reading on its own (staging throughput fell to 1,100 per second).

Revisit if: peak load passes 8,000 readings per second, or the vendor publishes a stable schema.
